name: narrate
title: Narrate
description: Read Claude Code responses and selected text aloud through the local narrate engine.
author: trenaryja

commands.name: recent-messages
commands.title: Recent Messages
commands.subtitle: Narrate
commands.description: Play, summarize, or copy recent Claude Code responses.

commands.name: read-selection
commands.title: Read Selection
commands.subtitle: Narrate
commands.description: Read the text selected in the frontmost app aloud.

commands.name: choose-voice
commands.title: Choose Voice
commands.subtitle: Narrate
commands.description: Set the voice and backend that read your messages, and hear it before you commit.

commands.name: playback-status
commands.title: Playback Status
commands.subtitle: Narrate
commands.description: Follow the narration sentence by sentence; select a sentence to jump to it.

commands.name: speed-up
commands.title: Speed Up
commands.subtitle: Narrate
commands.description: Raise the playback rate by 0.25× without restarting.

commands.name: slow-down
commands.title: Slow Down
commands.subtitle: Narrate
commands.description: Lower the playback rate by 0.25× without restarting.

preferences.name: summarizer
preferences.title: Summarize with
preferences.description: Summarize & Play runs this CLI on your Mac and spends your tokens. Off means messages are only ever read in full.

preferences.name: cacheLimitMb
preferences.title: Audio cache limit (MB)
preferences.description: Oldest clips are deleted after a narration to stay under this. 0 keeps everything.
